descriptions.text: Stuffed Grulke Infantry Figure. (With tags) This is the most common variation of the Grulke line of collectible figures. In terms of rarity, these things clock in just below frat boys with early-onset liver disease. It's literally not possible to enter a waystation kinder shop and not find one of these for sale on the shelf. You'll be hard-pressed to find a collector who will buy this off you. It sure is cute, though.

beats.headline: A beanbag with its tag on
beats.text: Bautista's quest to kill Miss Quill failed when Carl's party killed her by accident, blowing a hole in the ceiling of the magistrate's office, and when he got into her apartment it was empty except for stuffed monsters, more than a thousand of them. He tosses Carl one: a brown frog in a spiked helmet, tag still on, the same creature Mordecai is shape-shifted into. The paper tag says only Grulke Infantry, Jaxbrin Amusements, Ltd. Pull the tag like a grenade, Bautista explains, throw it, and in about ten seconds it fights for you, or attacks you. The common ones last fifteen to thirty seconds. He has four more like it.

beats.headline: The frog con
beats.text: With smoke billowing out of Donut's hole in the wall and camels everywhere, Carl rips the tag off the stuffed grulke and tosses it into the alley. A mighty croak, and a level-15 toad stands there with a 25-second timer, asking what he is doing here. Carl asks him to hop out onto the street and over the city wall. You summoned me just to make me run, the grulke complains, and goes anyway, landing in front of two surprised camels and bounding out of sight. Soon a camel is telling Donut that frog creatures attacked the town hall.

beats.headline: Questions at the gate
beats.text: The storm ends, and the town survives. The camels do not retract the sails as usual; Langley says there are guards at the main gate now, and anti-air defences going up all around the city. Everyone is still allowed to come and go, but everyone is interrogated about grulke toads and gnomes. The laid-back town has become a city under siege.
